indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lineup_observations_fixture_id_observed_at_key ON public.lineup_observations USING btree (fixture_id, observed_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lineup_observations_pkey ON public.lineup_observations USING btree (id)

constraints.name: lineup_observations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND ((payload -> 'version'::text) = '1'::jsonb) AND ((payload ->> 'provider'::text) = provider) AND ((payload ->> 'event_id'::text) = external_id) AND ((payload ->> 'state'::text) = status) AND (((payload ->> 'fetched_at'::text))::timestamp with time zone = observed_at) AND (((status = 'unavailable'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'reason'::text) = 'prediction_excluded'::text) AND ((payload -> 'home'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) AND ((payload -> 'away'::text) = 'null'::jsonb)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['complete'::text, 'partial'::text])) AND ((payload ->> 'confirmation'::text) = 'provider'::text) AND (((payload -> 'home'::text) ->> 'team_id'::text) = home_external_id) AND (((payload -> 'away'::text) ->> 'team_id'::text) = away_external_id) AND (jsonb_typeof(((payload -> 'home'::text) -> 'starters'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(((payload -> 'away'::text) -> 'starters'::text)) = 'array'::text)))) IS TRUE))
